description: Defines an abstract class Admin_UI_Field used for representing data fields in the admin UI of Revive Adserver, including methods for setting/getting values, filtering, and sorting.

classes.name: Admin_UI_Field
classes.description: Abstract class for admin UI data fields, providing methods for managing field properties, filtering, and sorting.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the field.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the field.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of the field.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Sets the filter type based on a string input, mapping to predefined constants.

methods.name: setValueFromArray
methods.description: Sets the field's value from an array of field values.

methods.name: multiSort
methods.description: Sorts an array based on multiple criteria, similar to SQL ORDER BY.
